entries.bf37d519742e9048: Starting a 3-year medium-term management plan from fiscal 2024, under the basic theme 'Aiming for Permanent Creation of Corporate Value', it is working on building a mechanism for creating profit for the next generation and on developing human resources, with top priority on making issues visible. The final year, fiscal 2026, has as its basic theme 'Practicing Structural Reform Toward Visualizing Profit'. In addition, its medium- to long-term business strategy 'Business Strategy for Enhancing Corporate Value Over3,000' aims, looking ahead to 2030, to achieve revenue of over ¥300 billion, and states that it will pursue 'further growth strategy', 'improving capital efficiency', 'restructuring the portfolio', 'further enhancement of shareholder returns' and 'disposal of non-business assets'.

entries.cd09b5d7d5d5b5fc: This is a reportable segment that manufactures and sells steel doors for buildings and condominiums, partitions for schools, and residential doors and exterior products. Residential building materials are manufactured by consolidated subsidiaries including BX Nishiyama Tekko Co., Ltd., BX Kaneshin Co., Ltd. and Ecowood Co., Ltd., and building materials for buildings are manufactured by consolidated subsidiaries including BX Routes Co., Ltd., BX Tiaru Co., Ltd., BX Koun Co., Ltd. and BX Asahi Kenzai Co., Ltd.; the company purchases some of them and sells them. The equity-method affiliate Fuji Sash Co., Ltd. group also manufactures and sells these products.
